verdict.rationale: The department's own Online Services account lets a business view its filing and payment history, bills, and notices, which covers status visibility for filings and cases. That view sits behind an authenticated login rather than on public pages, and no public status-lookup tool for a filing, application, or case is evidenced; the STAR delivery schedule lookup is area-based, not case-specific. Missing for 10: a public (no-login) status lookup page, explicit application/case status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
